title: AdrOutputList
description: List of diagnostic and remediation execution results (ADR).

cursor.description: Next page cursor for diagnostic results (v4 logs meta.cursor): device history when start/end set; or alert latest-executions when moduleType is diagnostic. Not set when moduleType is both.

sort.description: Sort applied to history results (echo of request, e.g. -startTime).

remediationCursor.description: Next page cursor for remediation results (v4 logs meta.cursor): device history when start/end set; or alert latest-executions when moduleType is remediation.

AdrOutput.description: Diagnostic Source or Remediation Source execution result (output and metadata).

executedBy.description: User or principal that triggered the execution (when available)

remediationSourceId.description: Remediation Source module id when sourceType is remediationSource

executionStatus.description: Execution status name (enum string from collector pipeline)

triggeredType.description: How the execution was triggered (e.g. manual, automatic)

output.description: Script output / message captured for this execution

sourceType.description: Row kind: diagnosticSource or remediationSource (exact values as in the JSON response).

diagnosticSourceId.description: Diagnostic Source module id when sourceType is diagnosticSource

startTime.description: Execution start time in epoch seconds (UTC), when available

alertId.description: Alert id when the execution was tied to an alert (may be empty).

endTime.description: Execution end or log timestamp in epoch seconds (UTC), when available
